candidates.title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Offloading-aware early-exit inference that explicitly reduces both layer computation and weight movement, while preserving KV-cache correctness through dynamic hidden-state management; directly relevant to constrained-memory/offloaded LLM inference.

candidates.title: Physically Partitioned KVCache Format for CPU--GPU Load Balancing in MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Introduces a physical-residency-aware KV-cache abstraction and scheduling-only CPU/GPU load balancing for long-context MoE inference, with direct relevance to hierarchical memory, KV offload, and heterogeneous inference.

candidates.title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
candidates.reason: Systematic evaluation of modern KV-cache offloading on context-intensive workloads, identifying accuracy failure modes in low-rank key projection and landmark selection and proposing a simpler higher-accuracy alternative.

candidates.title: Reimagining Memory Access for LLM Inference: Compression-Aware Memory Controller Design
candidates.reason: Hardware/software co-design for lossless weight/KV-cache compression and context-dependent quantized memory access in the accelerator memory controller; directly relevant to inference memory bandwidth and capacity reduction.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Fresh September 2026 and adjacent inference-system search across offloading-aware early exit, CPU/GPU KV-cache placement, context-intensive KV offload, and compression-aware memory controllers, filtered against canonical monthly identity snapshots before submission.
